name: dicom-sr
label: DICOM SR (Medical Imaging)
description: DICOM Structured Reporting — medical imaging studies, series, instances for radiology apps

table_notes.dicom_patient: Core patient identity record linking DICOM demographics to an optional FHIR patient resource.
table_notes.dicom_study: Top-level imaging study record grouping all series acquired in a single clinical encounter.
table_notes.dicom_series: A single acquisition run within a study, sharing modality and acquisition parameters.
table_notes.dicom_instance: Individual SOP instance (image or SR document) with its storage location and transfer syntax.
table_notes.dicom_report: Radiologist structured report tied to a study, tracking findings, impression, and workflow status.

dicom_patient.name: id
dicom_patient.description: Internal surrogate key for this patient record

dicom_patient.name: patient_id
dicom_patient.description: DICOM Patient ID (tag 0010,0020) — typically MRN assigned by issuing institution

dicom_patient.name: patient_name
dicom_patient.description: DICOM Patient Name (tag 0010,0010) as JSONB with keys: family, given, middle, prefix, suffix

dicom_patient.name: sex
dicom_patient.description: Patient sex code: M=male, F=female, O=other (DICOM tag 0010,0040)

dicom_patient.name: fhir_patient_id
dicom_patient.description: References FHIR Patient resource for cross-system interoperability with HL7 FHIR

dicom_study.name: id
dicom_study.description: Internal surrogate key for this imaging study

dicom_study.name: study_instance_uid
dicom_study.description: DICOM Study Instance UID (tag 0020,000D) — globally unique identifier assigned by the modality

dicom_study.name: patient_id
dicom_study.description: References dicom_patient — the subject of this imaging study

dicom_study.name: study_date
dicom_study.description: Date the imaging study was performed (DICOM tag 0008,0020)

dicom_study.name: study_time
dicom_study.description: Time the imaging study started (DICOM tag 0008,0030)

dicom_study.name: study_description
dicom_study.description: Free-text description of the study protocol or clinical indication (DICOM tag 0008,1030)

dicom_study.name: modalities
dicom_study.description: Array of modality codes present in this study (e.g. ["CT", "SR"]) — DICOM Modalities in Study (0008,0061)

dicom_study.name: accession_number
dicom_study.description: RIS/HIS accession number linking study to the radiology order (DICOM tag 0008,0050)

dicom_study.name: referring_physician
dicom_study.description: Name of the physician who requested the study (DICOM tag 0008,0090)

dicom_study.name: institution
dicom_study.description: Name of the institution where the study was performed (DICOM tag 0008,0080)

dicom_study.name: num_series
dicom_study.description: Cached count of series belonging to this study (denormalized for query performance)

dicom_series.name: id
dicom_series.description: Internal surrogate key for this series

dicom_series.name: series_instance_uid
dicom_series.description: DICOM Series Instance UID (tag 0020,000E) — globally unique identifier for this acquisition run

dicom_series.name: study_id
dicom_series.description: References dicom_study — the parent study this series belongs to

dicom_series.name: series_number
dicom_series.description: Numeric label identifying this series within its study (DICOM tag 0020,0011)

dicom_series.name: series_description
dicom_series.description: Free-text description of the series (e.g. 'Axial T1 post-contrast') — DICOM tag 0008,103E

dicom_series.name: modality
dicom_series.description: DICOM modality code for this series (e.g. CT, MR, PT, SR, US) — tag 0008,0060

dicom_series.name: body_part
dicom_series.description: SNOMED-coded body part examined (DICOM tag 0018,0015), e.g. CHEST, BRAIN, ABDOMEN

dicom_series.name: num_instances
dicom_series.description: Cached count of SOP instances (images/documents) in this series

dicom_series.name: series_date
dicom_series.description: Date this series was acquired (DICOM tag 0008,0021)

dicom_instance.name: id
dicom_instance.description: Internal surrogate key for this SOP instance

dicom_instance.name: sop_instance_uid
dicom_instance.description: DICOM SOP Instance UID (tag 0008,0018) — globally unique identifier for this image or document

dicom_instance.name: series_id
dicom_instance.description: References dicom_series — the series this instance belongs to

dicom_instance.name: sop_class_uid
dicom_instance.description: DICOM SOP Class UID (tag 0008,0016) defining the object type (e.g. CT Image, Enhanced MR, Basic SR)

dicom_instance.name: instance_number
dicom_instance.description: Sequence number of this instance within its series (DICOM tag 0020,0013)

dicom_instance.name: storage_url
dicom_instance.description: Object storage URL (S3, GCS, WADO-RS) where the DICOM file is persisted

dicom_instance.name: transfer_syntax
dicom_instance.description: DICOM Transfer Syntax UID (tag 0002,0010) specifying encoding/compression (e.g. JPEG 2000, JPEG Baseline)

dicom_instance.name: file_size_bytes
dicom_instance.description: Size of the stored DICOM file in bytes, used for storage quota and retrieval planning

dicom_instance.name: content_date
dicom_instance.description: Date the content was created (DICOM tag 0008,0023), may differ from acquisition date for SR documents

dicom_instance.name: metadata
dicom_instance.description: Supplementary DICOM tag values as JSONB {tag: value} — pixel spacing, slice thickness, window center/width, etc.

dicom_report.name: id
dicom_report.description: Internal surrogate key for this radiology report

dicom_report.name: study_id
dicom_report.description: References dicom_study — the imaging study this report describes

dicom_report.name: report_type
dicom_report.description: Report template or category (e.g. Preliminary, Final, Addendum, Consultation)

dicom_report.name: radiologist
dicom_report.description: Name of the radiologist who authored or finalized this report

dicom_report.name: status
dicom_report.description: Report workflow status: draft, preliminary, final, amended, cancelled

dicom_report.name: findings
dicom_report.description: Detailed radiologist observations describing image findings for each anatomical region

dicom_report.name: impression
dicom_report.description: Clinical interpretation summary and conclusions — the referring physician's primary read target

dicom_report.name: created_at
dicom_report.description: Timestamp when this report record was first created

dicom_report.name: finalized_at
dicom_report.description: Timestamp when the report reached final/signed status (NULL if still in progress)

short_description: DICOM Structured Reporting — medical imaging studies, series, instances for radiology apps
long_description: DICOM (Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine) is the universal ISO/IEEE standard for medical imaging, used in every hospital radiology department worldwide. The Structured Reporting schema covers the four-level DICOM hierarchy: patient demographics, imaging study metadata, series within a study, and individual image instances, plus radiologist report content.
when_to_use: Use for PACS (Picture Archiving and Communication System) software, radiology AI tools, teleradiology platforms, or any clinical application that handles medical images. Required by FDA for medical device software (SaMD) that processes medical images. The HL7 FHIR ImagingStudy resource references DICOM UIDs, making this the bridge between clinical records and imaging.
